NOTICE NO. 1
Government Notice
Retirement of Commissioned Offi cers
His Excellency the President has been pleased to approve the Retirement of
Commissioned Offi cers in the Reserve Force of the Barbados Defence Force to:
a. the retirement of Lieutenant (Coast Guard) Rohan Riley from the Reserve Force
with eff ect from 29 November 2025;
b. the transfer of Lieutenant Josette Sam to the Second Class of the Reserve with
eff ect from 30 April 2025;
c. the retirement of Second Lieutenant Mary Walker from the Reserve Force with
eff ect from 19 November 2015; and her transfer to the Second Class of the Reserve with
eff ect from 19 November 2015 until 19 November 2027;
d. the transfer of Midshipman Matthew Hinkson to the Second Class of the
Reserve with eff ect from 1 September 2025.
(M.P. 10/1/4/ 2 Vol.II)
2 OFFICIAL GAZETTE April 6, 2026
GOVERNMENT NOTICE
Grant of Continuance of Service
His Excellency the President has been pleased to approve the Grant of Continuance
of Service in Barbados Defence Force to:
a. Lieutenant Colonel Julia DaBreo for two (2) years as a Regular Offi cer in the
Barbados Defence Force from 15 March 2026 until 15 March 2028.
b. Major Len Cummins for three (3) years as a Reserve Offi cer in the Barbados
Cadet Corps from 25 May 2026 until 25 May 2029.
c. Major Andrew Darlington for three (3) years as a Reserve Offi cer in the Barbados
Defence Force from 5 June 2026 to 5 June 2029.
d. Major Naomi Williams for three (3) years as a Reserve Offi cer in the Barbados
Cadet Corps from 15 April 2026 until 15 April 2029.
e. Sub-Lieutenant Kirk Holder for two (2) years as a Regular Offi cer in the
Barbados Defence Force from 2 December 2025 until 2 December 2027.
f. Lieutenant Rose-Ann Bennett for three (3) years as a Reserve Offi cer in the
Barbados Defence Force from 26 April 2025 until 26 April 2028.
g. Second Lieutenant Gregory Thompson for three (3) years as a Reserve Offi cer
in the Barbados Cadet Corps, 12 March 2026 until 12 March 2029.
(M.P. 10/1/4/ 2 Vol.II)
